name: GitHub
description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search through GitHub's official remote MCP server.

auth.tokenHelp: Create a fine-grained personal access token with only the repositories and permissions you need.

verification.notes: URL from the official github-mcp-server README. GitHub OAuth needs a pre-registered GitHub App (no DCR/CIMD), so the entry uses a personal access token sent as a bearer token. The server reports read-only hints on its tools.
